proof-narrative-lean-equiv.evidence: S↔L: ref resolves only to the sibling (no library decl). `tr_M₁ tr_M₂ : ℝ` are arbitrary reals and `J₁ := C * tr_M₁` (lean:53) defines the Jones value as C·tr. The theorem is then the tautology C·a/(C·b) = a/b over hypothesised values; no braid, trace or Jones polynomial appears. Several further problems. (i) The writhe factor that the docstring says belongs to C (lean:35, "(-q^{-3/2})^{-w(β)}") is dropped from `jonesNormFactor` (lean:40). (ii) The Gram/LP/shadow-price claim (md:11) has no Lean content; `gram_entry_proportional` is `C * x = C * x := rfl` (lean:76-77). (iii) Real-only q > 0 is gratuitous for an algebraic cancellation. S↔P: the statement asserts J_{K1}/J_{K2} = tr_M(β1)/tr_M(β2) for all β1, β2 ∈ B_n with a writhe-free C (md:1). The prf itself says C carries (-q^{-3/2})^{-w(β)} and "cancels in ratios of braids with the same writhe" (prf:5-6); for different writhes it is "applied post-hoc" (prf:7-8). The statement therefore claims more than is proved: an equal-writhe hypothesis is missing. The "global scalar" claim for G_ij = tr_M(b_i b_j) (md:11) fails for the same reason, since the correction depends on w(b_i)+w(b_j) and is not global. The loop prefactor q^{1/2}+q^{-1/2} is also the one retracted under convention D in markov-pair-z2.ts:34.

trap-nonspeakable.notes: Two out-of-criterion notes. (1) STATEMENT/PROOF MISMATCH: this block gives C(n,q) = (-q^{1/2}-q^{-1/2})^{n-1} with no writhe factor, while its proof sibling gives C(n,q) = (-q^{1/2}-q^{-1/2})^{n-1} (-q^{-3/2})^{-w(beta)} and explicitly notes the writhe term only cancels for equal-writhe braids; as stated here the proposition is false for braids of different writhe. (2) CONVENTION: that C is the loop value (-1/z)^{n-1} at convention C, since 1/(q^{1/2}+q^{-1/2}) is exactly z_C; under production convention D the loop value is 1/z_D = (q^2+1)/q^3. Not load-bearing for the ratio claim (any C depending only on n, q, w cancels), but the identity J = C tr_M as written is convention-C-tied. Cross-check: z/z_- = q^4 identically at D but not at C (symbolic), i.e. only D kills l(lambda)>=3, so the Jones/TL reading belongs to D.
